utterances.text: If I may summarize briefly, it deals, as you already mentioned, with your son Erxhan Ali. Where was that document recorded?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: This document was recorded in the Skopje Court.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And on that occasion, obviously your child Erxhan was discussed, but my question to you is: When you came to the Skopje Court that day in March 2002, did the persons who were present also ask you what happened to you yourself, at the police stations in Prolece and Bit Pazar, in mid-August 2001?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: No, they didn't. They only asked me about Erxhan.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And can you tell us at any point in time after you had been released from Sutka prison, were you ever questioned by the Macedonian authorities about your own fate, about the mistreatment you received at the police stations and at Skopje Court in August 2001?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: How is your medical condition today?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Very bad. I have pain on the right side and I also have pain in my kidneys.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I finally want to use the picture which is in tab 1 of your binder.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: For the record, I will read it out. It's N004-4713. 65 ter number is 199.8. Maybe the larger picture could be placed on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I ask you to point out where your house was in August 2001. Maybe the easiest --

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Here.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you maybe on the ELMO, because this is the largest picture it is the easily visible, point out where your house is?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If the technician could zoom a little bit to the right -- or move a little bit to the right-hand side of the picture. Could the technician please -- or may the usher move -- yeah, thank you. If the usher could please give the witness a ball pencil that he can encircle his house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Please, on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Would you mark a 1 next to this, please.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Thank you. And what happened to your house on Sunday, the 12th of August, 2001?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: On this Sunday, in August 2001 we were in the basement in this house. In the morning, a shell fell here from the Macedonian forces. It fell on my house. We stayed there until 6.00 in the afternoon, and from there --

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I stop you for one second. What happened when the shell fell on your house? What happened to your house?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: It destroyed the entire roof of the house and the shell fell inside the room and destroyed the room. Only the basement was not touched by the grenade.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And I interrupted you. If you could please go on. You said you stayed until 6.00 in the afternoon. And then?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: We then left the house and we walked through the yards of neighbours' house. And when we arrived at Adem Ademi's meadow, I wanted to get on the road, and there I saw Sulejmani killed.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can you mark from your house to where you took on that day?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And where did you see the body lying?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can you point to that place, please.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [Indicates]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If you could just encircle that and mark it with a 2, please.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Just one clarifying question. You said you saw Sulejmani killed. Who are you referring to by Sulejmani?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Sulejman Jashari.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Are you sure about the last name, because yesterday evening you told me another name.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I apologise. It's Sulejman Bajrami.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Why do you believe it was Sulejman Bajrami?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Well, first of all, he is my neighbour; and he is also a cousin of mine, a relative.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Was this the only body you saw that day?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes. I only saw Sulejman.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Are you planning to tender that last --

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: -- sketch?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I just noticed that I have one more question. I apologise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Well, this photograph as marked will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P265, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: One more clarifying question. You mentioned Kodra e Zajmit and Buzalak. Are these names in the Albanian and Macedonian language for one and the same place?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, this is a name.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: The name for the same place, this was my question, or are these different places?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Buzalak is a different place from Kodra e Zajmit. Kodra e Zajmit is the Albanian term for this location, while in Macedonian it is Zajmski Rid [phoen].

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: What I fail to understand is are we talking about one and the same locations or about different locations, if you could please clarify?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: We are talking about different locations. Buzalak is nearer to the village, while Kodra e Zajmit, it's about three or four kilometres further down, in the direction of Skopje.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: No further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Mettraux.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Ali. My name is Guenael Mettraux and together with my colleague Edina Residovic I'm representing Mr. Boskoski. Before we start, Mr. Ali, I would like to express our sincere condolences for the loss of your son on behalf of Mr. Boskoski and the members of the team. Sir, I would like to take you back to Friday, the 10th of August. You will recall in your statement you have indicated to the Prosecution that shelling onto the village started around 8.00 in the morning. Can you remember that, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And I understood you told the Prosecution that the shelling lasted for approximately two hours or a couple of hours; is that correct, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that correct also that you then went to work in your field?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I went in the fields in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Do you recall -- can you recall, sir, approximately at what time you went?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: At around 3.00 p.m. In the afternoon, I'm not exactly sure. At about 3.00 in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Can you recall with whom you went to the field on that day and at that time?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I was with Musliu Rexhepi.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is it correct that your brother Vehap also accompanied you on that day?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Where do you mean?

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: To the field, sir.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I don't know. I didn't reach the field because of the shelling. We stopped on the road. We stayed there with Musliu, and when my son was killed, I returned back.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: But my question, sir, was, was your brother Vehap accompanying you on that day when you went towards your field?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: No, he wasn't.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, Your Honour, if I may ask that this witness be shown 1D188. It's ERN 1D002116, and the correct page would be 2121, Your Honour, and that is the addendum of that witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, this is the record that we received from the Prosecution of a meeting which you had on the 26th of April, 2007 with representatives of the Prosecution. And you are -- you are recorded as saying the following: "I have been together with my brother Vehap Ali (all the time during this weekend in August)." Is that what you told the Prosecutor, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I wasn't at the field with my brother. When I returned back at home when Erxhan was killed I found my brother in the house at home.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, can the witness be shown 1D193, that would be 1D002173, and for the registry's benefit, there is a translation in Macedonian at 1D002181.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, the document that I'm going to show you is a statement taken by Xhavit Ali. Sir, is that your father?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'll ask the registry to turn to the second page of that document, and if is it technically feasible to focus on paragraph 3 of that statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Can you see paragraph 3 of that document, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'll read it out to you. It says this: "On Friday of 10 August 2001 at about 10.00 a.m., shelling started. I was at the house of my brother Avdil Aliu. My wife, my daughter, and my nephews and one niece were in my house. My two sons, Isni Ali and Vehap Ali, were working on our tobacco field which is two kilometres from my house in the direction of Rastak." Can you see that? Can you see that, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I haven't heard anything.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the usher verify if Mr. Ali has the Albanian channel on, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is all right now.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, I will read the passage again. As I mentioned earlier, this comes from the statement taken from your father, Xhavit on the 4th of October 2004. And it read as follows. "On Friday of 10 August 2001, at about 10.00 a.m., shelling started. I was at the house of my brother Avdil Aliu, my wife, my daughter and my two nephews and one niece were in my house. My two sons Isni Ali and Vehap Ali were working on our tobacco field which is about two kilometres from my house in the direction of Rastak? Can you see this?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, I can see.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that is not sure about the exact time when the shelling started and that is only an estimation. Sir, what your father told the Prosecutor on the 4th of October, 2004 was that you and your brother were in the field on that day; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: We went -- we start to go to the field, but he didn't know when the shelling started. I returned to the home of my uncle, Ramadan Aliu. His house was nearby. He thought that we went to the field.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, sir, when you returned from the field, did you go to the house of your uncle, Ramadan Aliu or did you go to the house of your uncle Avdil?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: We didn't go to the field in the morning, because when the shelling started, it started as of 8.00 in the morning with light weapons. We went to the house of my uncle Ramadan Aliu. We stayed there for about one or two hours. I'm not sure how much we stayed, and then returned back home. Then the heavier shelling started. We stayed there until 2.00 at home and all the relatives and uncles gathered in the basement. Then when the shelling stopped we set off for the field.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: You've indicated you in fact did not go to work at the field; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: You said that on your way to the field the shelling started again; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And you said that because the shelling had started again, you went to the house of your uncle Ramadan Aliu; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, could the witness please be shown his statement. It's under P63 and that would be the second page.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, I'd ask you to look at the -- do you have the statement in front of you, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, I have it.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And I'd ask you to focus on paragraph 3 which I will read out to you. It is the last sentence, sir. It says this: "We went to our tobacco field along with Musliu Rexhepi. The field is about 300 metres away from my house." Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then at paragraph 4 you go on to say this: "At about 5.00 in the afternoon we were still in the field when we heard that the shelling and shooting from the same direction as before started again." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: "Then we went into the basement of my uncle Avdil Aliu's house. We were about ten people" --

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Avdil Aliu, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: "We were about ten people in the basement and I made a phone call from one of my neighbour's mobile phone." Sir, is this Avdil Aliu the same person as Ramadan Aliu?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. You've indicated, I think, that as you returned to the house --

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Ramadan Aliu is Avdil Aliu's brother.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And do they live in the same house, sir?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Ramadan Aliu has another house, it's a different house.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So, sir, which house did you go to when you returned having attempted to go to the field, to the house of Ramadan Aliu or the house of Avdil Aliu, as you have said in your statement?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: In the morning, I was in the house of Ramadan Aliu.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: But, sir, you have just said that you went or tried to go to the field at 3.00 in the afternoon; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that's the afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes. The afternoon. When we set off to the field we stopped to talk, to Musliu Rexhepi and while we were talking the shelling started and I then returned to the house of Avdil Aliu.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Now are you saying, sir, that you did not go to the house of Ramadan Aliu, is that correct, is that your evidence?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Not in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So what you said earlier that you went to the house in the basement -- in the house, I'm sorry, of Ramadan Aliu upon returning from the field was incorrect. Do I understand you properly?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: When we returned back from the field, we didn't go to the house of Ramadan Aliu.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Very well. Then you are now saying that went back to the house of your uncle Avdil. I understand you to be saying that there were a number of people in the house at the time. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: There was my uncle, the wives of the uncles and a neighbour who were sticking the tobacco.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: When you say your uncle was present, you're talking about Avdil, aren't you?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: What about your brother Vehap. Was he with you at this stage?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: No. The brother was at home.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So when you have indicated to the Prosecutor that you spent your entire weekend with your brother Vehap, that was not exactly correct, is it?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: On Friday, when Erxhan was killed, when I was informed at my uncle's house by phone, I went at my home, I found Vehap there at my father's home.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So the answer to my question, sir, is no, you didn't spend the entire weekend with your brother Vehap, is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: I spent from the Friday until the time when you were captured by the police and sent to the police station.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Very well. And as you were in --

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: On Sunday.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: As you were back in the house of your uncle Avdil, you didn't see him leave the house at any stage, did you?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Vehap was not at Avdil's house.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'm sorry, sir, perhaps I didn't put my question very properly to you. I was asking about your uncle Avdil. You explained that you returned from your attempt to go to your field to the house of Avdil and that Avdil was present at the time. My question is: : Whilst you were back at the house of Avdil,, you did not see him leave that house at any stage on that day, right?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: At the time when we were at Avdil's home at around 5.00, there were Avdil, his wife, his children, and two neighbours, and they were curing tobacco.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And your cousin Erhan was not present at the house at that time; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Do you know where he was, sir, at the time?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: No. As I was told at home, they were on their way home. I don't know exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct that you stated to the Prosecutor that as you were in Mr. Avdil's Aliu's house, you tried to call your own home, first on a mobile phone and then on a land line. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And your wife answered your call on that occasion; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And she informed you that your son Erxhan had been killed; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then you told the Prosecution that the next day, on Saturday, the 11th, at around 2.00 in the afternoon, you managed eventually to bury your son; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So, sir, if someone were to claim that it's not your wife but your uncle who told you that your son was dead, he or she would not be telling the truth; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: It is my wife who told me on the phone.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, I'll repeat my question. If a person were to claim that it was he who told you about the death of your son and not your wife, he would not be saying the truth; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes, he lies.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if that person was your uncle, sir, he would be lying, wouldn't he?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, I will ask that the witness be shown 1D192. It is ERN 1D002165. And I do not believe we have a Macedonian translation, Your Honour, so I will read the passage. I would kindly ask the registry to go to the third page of that statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, this is again a statement of your uncle Avdil Aliu taken by the office of the prosecutor at the end of the month of October 2003, and I would like to you focus on paragraph 7 of that document. Can you see it, sir? I apologise, it is in English only, so I'll read it out to you.

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: This is what your uncle said: "Then I came back to the basement of my house and I told my children to stop the work. The shelling and shooting lasted all the while. At the time when dusk was falling I inferred Isni about the death of his son. Then we moved everybody to Isni's house." So, sir, you're saying this is incorrect, isn't it? This is wrong?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: When my son was killed all people came to my house, this is correct, but it is my wife who told me on the phone that Erxhan was killed.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if someone was saying that Erxhan was buried not in the afternoon and not at 2.00 in the afternoon but in the evening on Saturday afternoon and not by you but by three other people, again this person would be lying; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ISNI ALI
utterances.text: The -- he was buried by Fasli, who is now dead, the uncles, and I was present there. The burial was done at 2.00. Maybe not exactly at 2.00, but we didn't have -- we couldn't see the hour, the time. We were all traumatised. We didn't know where we were.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the witness please be shown 1D193. That is ERN 1D002173. And in the Macedonian version it is 1D002181. Your Honour, I see the time. Would you like me it continue for a few minutes?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: I'm afraid we really should bring it to an end, Mr. Mettraux. We will continue tomorrow at 9.00 in the morning. Could I mention one matter so that counsel can plan accordingly and in particular Mr. Saxon. Circumstances have arisen which indicate that it will not be feasible for the Chamber to sit on the Friday of next week. So that if you could plan your witness -- future witness list accordingly, Mr. Saxon.

utterances.speaker: MR. SAXON
utterances.text: Thank you for the information, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: So a week and a half away, not the coming Friday. We will adjourn now until tomorrow at 9.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 14th day of June, 2007, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.48 p.m.,
